name: Adelta (Autodiff for Discontinuous Programs)
aliases: Pre-filtering with 1D Box Kernel for Gradient Approximation
definition: A compiler-based approach to extend reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD) to accept arbitrary programs involving discontinuities by approximating the prefiltered gradient over a box kernel oriented along a 1D sampling axis.
summary: Adelta is a compiler-based approach that extends reverse-mode automatic differentiation to discontinuous programs by approximating prefiltered gradients over a 1D box kernel, achieving O(1) complexity relative to parameter count.
